# Pixcuro

> Free image tools that run in your browser. Background remover, compressor, resizer, cropper, converter and watermark — privacy-first, no signup.

## What this site does

Pixcuro provides browser-based image tools for common tasks:

- Remove image backgrounds (AI model running locally in the browser)
- Change or replace image backgrounds with solid colors, gradients, blur, or uploaded images
- Compress JPG/PNG/WebP images with adjustable quality
- Resize images to exact dimensions, by percentage, or via social-media presets
- Crop images interactively with aspect-ratio lock
- Convert between JPG, PNG and WebP
- Apply photo adjustments (brightness, contrast, saturation, sharpness, temperature)
- Add text or image watermarks
- Strip EXIF / metadata by re-encoding
- Build printable photo sheets (PDF, PNG, JPG) for passport / ID photos
- Batch compress, resize and convert multiple images and download as a ZIP

## Privacy model

Every tool runs entirely in your browser:

- Images are not uploaded to any server.
- The background-removal AI runs via WebAssembly / ONNX locally on your device.
- There is no signup, no tracking pixels, and no analytics by default.
- The only data sent to a server is the static HTML/JS/CSS of the site itself.

## Supported formats

- Input: PNG, JPG / JPEG, WebP, BMP, GIF
- Output: PNG (lossless, transparency), JPG (smaller), WebP (modern)
- Printable PDF output for photo sheets
- ZIP output for batch operations

## Page index

- /  — Homepage with hero upload and categorized tool list

- /llms.txt  — This file

## Important limitations

- Background removal is best-effort; very busy backgrounds or low-contrast subjects may need manual cleanup.
- Passport photo sizes are commonly reported starting points. Verify the exact requirements with the issuing authority before submission.
- Browser-only processing means the first background-removal run downloads a ~40 MB model to the browser cache. Subsequent uses are instant.
- Maximum input file size: 25 MB.
